readme.run: Segment brain tissue, and white matter hyperintensities with a FLAIR
notes: Runs the web app's BISON pipeline on the CPU: denoising, N4, intensity
normalisation, registration to ICBM 2009c and the random forest. A T1 alone
gives 8 tissue classes; adding --flair gives BISON-WMH's 9 with white matter
hyperintensities. It writes the labels, one probability map per class and the
brain mask on the T1 grid, the same files as the web app.
A run takes about 15 to 20 minutes and 3 GB of memory. The model files are
included, so no network connection is required. Input is NIfTI only: convert
DICOM with dcm2niix first, or use the web app. Add --help for every setting.
